vf.vpn.howto: Before verifying: turn off VPN, proxy and Private Relay
vf.vpn.lead: If your IP exits through a tunnel (Nord, Express, WARP, Opera VPN, Tor, iCloud Private Relay…) verification is blocked. Turn it off, reload, then tap the lobster again.
vf.vpn.iphone.title: iPhone / iPad
vf.vpn.iphone.1: Private Relay: Settings → your name → iCloud → Private Relay → Off.
vf.vpn.iphone.2: Safari: Settings → Safari (or Apps → Safari) → Hide IP Address → Off.
vf.vpn.iphone.3: VPN: Settings → General → VPN & Device Management (iOS 18: Settings → VPN & Device Management) → disconnect the profile.
vf.vpn.iphone.4: Quit Nord, Express, Surfshark, Proton, 1.1.1.1 / WARP, AdGuard VPN. The status-bar VPN icon must disappear.
vf.vpn.iphone.5: Fully close Safari (app switcher → swipe up) and open this link again.
vf.vpn.android.title: Android
vf.vpn.android.1: Settings → Network & internet → VPN → disconnect the active session.
vf.vpn.android.2: Turn off Always-on VPN so it does not reconnect by itself.
vf.vpn.android.3: Open Nord / Express / Surfshark / Proton / 1.1.1.1 WARP / Opera and tap disconnect.
vf.vpn.android.4: Do not use Opera's built-in VPN or Chrome extensions like Hola / Urban VPN.
vf.vpn.android.5: Force-close the browser and open dabot.davito.es/verify again.
vf.vpn.web.title: Browser (desktop)
vf.vpn.web.1: Chrome / Edge: chrome://extensions or edge://extensions — disable Urban VPN, Proton, Hotspot Shield, Hola, SetupVPN, Touch VPN.
vf.vpn.web.2: Firefox: about:addons → Extensions → disable any VPN/proxy.
vf.vpn.web.3: Opera / GX: Settings → VPN → Off. Opera's orange VPN counts too.
vf.vpn.web.4: Close Tor Browser. Disconnect WARP / 1.1.1.1, Tailscale exit nodes, WireGuard or OpenVPN on the OS.
vf.vpn.web.5: Reload this page or tap Check network again.

pr.intro: Dabot is a Discord bot and a web panel. We collect the minimum data needed for the bot to work on your server.
pr.li.ids: Discord IDs of users, roles, channels and servers where the bot is invited.
pr.li.content: Content needed for features you enable: infractions, XP, economy, tickets, suggestions, reminders, welcome messages and, if you use the chatbot, conversation snippets and memories a user asks to keep.
pr.li.panel: Web panel: OAuth session (Discord id, name, avatar and access token) for 7 days.
pr.li.verify: Verification / anti-multi-account: if a server enables web verification, network and device signals are stored (hashed for that server's staff: exact-match and subnet codes). Verifications via VPN, proxy, Tor or iCloud Private Relay are rejected. Staff do not see plain IP addresses.
pr.li.logs: Optional logs (deleted/edited messages) only if an admin sets an audit channel.
pr.li.nosell: We don't sell data. We don't advertise with your server.
pr.li.noread: We don't read a server's full history except for modules staff enable (AI, logs, levels).
pr.li.scopes: The panel does not request the messages scope; only identify and guilds.
pr.third: Discord (API). AI providers the bot uses when someone mentions Dabot or runs AI commands (the text sent is the command or mention). Hosting on the davito.es VPS.
pr.retention: If you kick the bot, you can request deletion of that server's data by contacting Davito via davito.es. Web sessions expire after 7 days or when you log out.
pr.minors: Dabot is not intended to collect data from children under 13. It follows Discord content rules; public slash command names are not sexually explicit.
pr.contact: Contact: via davito.es or the bot's support server.
te.1: Dabot is provided “as is”. Davito may change modules, pause the service or remove the bot from a server that abuses it (raid, spam, malware).
te.2: You are responsible for the permissions you grant the bot and for following Discord's terms.
te.3: Premium features (structure backups, extended AI) may require a subscription. No automatic refunds except where the law requires.
te.4: Do not use Dabot for harassment, illegal content or to evade Discord rules. The operator may delete data or deny service.
te.5: The web panel is only for people who can manage the server or have an assigned staff role.
te.6: Web verification stores anti-abuse signals (device, browser and network codes) for that server's staff. Sharing intelligence across servers needs explicit approval from Dabot's operator.
te.7: These terms are read together with the privacy policy.
